---
title: "Teach on Start + Void"
description: "Native Teach Worker, qualification commands, cutover packet and Vercel rollback."
updatedAt: "2026-11-09"
audience: developers
---

Teach (`apps/teach`) runs as a native TanStack Start app on Vite+ and Void through
[`@tuturuuu/start-bridge`](/build/devops/start-bridge), produced by the
[conversion codemod](/build/devops/start-bridge-codemod). All 44 App Router pages
render unchanged through the generic RSC adapter and every route handler is served
by the bridge API registry. `next build` (package `build`) remains the Vercel path;
production publication stays held in `tuturuuu.ci.ts` until a cutover PR.

## Cutover packet

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Worker | `void.config.ts` emits the staging identity `tuturuuu-teach-vite-staging` (`TUTURUUU_NOINDEX=1`, `workers_dev` on). Deploy the production artifact under `tuturuuu-teach` with the deploy-time name override, `workers_dev` off and `TUTURUUU_NOINDEX` unset. The config declares no routes |
| Hosts | Root: `teach.tuturuuu.com`. Mount: `tuturuuu.com/teach` |
| Bindings | `ASSETS` (static assets, worker-first, no SPA fallback) |
| Vars (names) | `INTERNAL_WEB_API_ORIGIN` (default `https://tuturuuu.com`), `TUTURUUU_NOINDEX` (staging only) |
| Secrets (names) | `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`, `SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY`, `TUTURUUU_APP_COORDINATION_SECRET`. Optional integrations keep the names in `apps/teach/env.example` |
| Build | `bun turbo:local run build --filter=@tuturuuu/teach^...`, then `bun run --cwd apps/teach build:cloudflare`. Output: `dist/server/wrangler.json`, `dist/client` |
| Routing | Attach only `teach.tuturuuu.com/*`. Do not attach `tuturuuu.com/*` |
| Prior Vercel deployment | Not recorded in the repository. The release owner captures the production deployment id and DNS record before the flip |

Unlike Track and Tasks, `start-bridge.config.ts` does not set
`unknownHost: 'reject'`, so the Worker is not restricted to its two declared hosts.
Keep `workers_dev` off and attach only the Teach route in production.

## Rollback

Remove only the `teach.tuturuuu.com/*` Worker route, or restore the captured DNS
record, so the hostname returns to the captured immutable Vercel deployment. Do not
rebuild and do not promote the Vercel project. The Worker holds no state; Teach
data stays in Supabase and Storage, which the rollback does not touch.

## Smoke

```bash
node scripts/native-cutover/smoke.mjs --origin https://teach.tuturuuu.com --app teach --expect native
curl -sI https://teach.tuturuuu.com/api/build-info            # 200, no-store
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://teach.tuturuuu.com/          # 200, landing page renders
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://teach.tuturuuu.com/login     # 200, login page renders
curl -sI https://teach.tuturuuu.com/en/dashboard              # redirects when signed out, never 5xx
```

Every response carries the Teach SEO robots header and the private cache policy.
The rollback smoke is the same command with `--expect legacy`.

## Qualification

`teach-cloudflare.yaml` builds the native output, rejects route-tree drift,
type-checks (`type-check:cloudflare`), seals the emitted Worker with
`scripts/ci/teach-native-artifact.py` and runs the emitted-Worker suite in workerd
(`bun run --cwd apps/teach test:runtime`, 7 tests, egress denied). The 404 probe
uses `/login/__native-smoke-missing__` because every non-public path redirects
signed-out users to login. `/api/build-info` is public to GET and HEAD through
`proxy.ts`, with ambient cookies and authorization removed, as in Track and Tasks.
Heavy builds run on a remote host, not the local hub.
